name: codemat
description: CodeMat (Comp & Mat) — learn programming and math with interactive exercises

scripts.apphosting:build: npm run build:content && npm run build -w apps/web && mkdir -p apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/public apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/.next && cp -r apps/web/public/. apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/public/ && cp -r apps/web/.next/static apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/.next/static
scripts.build: npm run build:content && npm run build -w apps/functions && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:deploy: npm run build:content && npm run build -w apps/functions
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/functions
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/functions
